score_basis: Basic optional budgets, inclusive limits, shared spending, diamond reuse, binding and per-call reset work. Two explicit branch requirements are incomplete: nested invalid candidates abort before a later valid candidate, and cycle identity omits the derived verification key and therefore skips a chargeable attempt. Both are localized but material correctness defects in the requested bounded validator. No engineering or helper errors are used as score penalties; no claim of an unbounded exploit.
